title: Shortlists
description: Save players, write your own notes, and compare up to five side by side. Nothing here is visible to anyone else.
exportTitle: Export is scoped to your own selections
exportBody: A shortlist exports as CSV with the columns you can already see, plus your notes. There is no bulk export of the underlying provider database, and none will be added.

signedOut.title: Sign in to keep shortlists
signedOut.description: Everything else on this site is open. An account exists only so that a shortlist has an owner — yours, and no-one else's.

index.emptyDescription: Create one, then save players to it from any player profile.
index.name: Name

detail.comparisonFailed: That comparison could not be shown. Choose up to {max} players from this shortlist.
detail.deleteDescription: The players and your notes go with it. This cannot be undone.
detail.privateBefore: Only you can see this list.

entries.atLimit: That is the maximum — a wider table stops being readable.

comparison.heading: Comparing {count} player
comparison.watchOutsEmpty: Nothing in the lower band of this role.
comparison.caveatTitle: These columns are not measured against the same population
comparison.footnote: The highlighted figure in each row is the largest per 90 minutes, not the best player: it compares quantities, which are the same everywhere, rather than percentiles, which are ranks inside each player's own competition.

statusDescriptions.priority: A target you would move for.
statusDescriptions.rejected: Ruled out, and kept so the reason is not lost.
